The defendants No.1 to 3 have entered appearance through their counsel and filed written / 21 /

Further submitted that, the true fact is, BDA has acquired land in Sy.No.54 of N.S.Palya to an extent of 08 Acres 02 Guntas for the formation of BTM Layout and / 22 / O.S.No.273/2019 sites were formed and allotted to the applicants.

Further state that, the plaintiff is wrongly claiming two sites as suit schedule properties situated in Sy.No.54 of N.S.Palya.
The BDA has acquired land in Sy.No.54 of N.S.Palya to an extent of 8 Acres 2 Guntas for / 24 /
